title: Add footer, basic admin system, and notification system

requirements.summary: Add permanent footer with 'Made by SC05 Sohail Ch' to all pages
acceptanceCriteria: Footer appears on all pages with the exact text 'Made by SC05 Sohail Ch'
Footer is styled consistently with the existing design
Footer remains visible at the bottom of the page

file_operations.description: Update the existing footer section to include the permanent text 'Made by SC05 Sohail Ch' alongside the existing caffeine.ai attribution. Style it consistently with the current footer design using the warm earth-tone color scheme from the global CSS.

requirements.summary: Add frontend interface for manually assigning admin privileges to users
acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel includes a form to assign admin role by entering email or username
Form provides feedback on successful admin assignment
Only existing admins can access this admin assignment interface

file_operations.description: Create a new admin panel page that allows admins to assign admin privileges to other users. Include a form with input for entering a Principal ID (since the backend uses Principal for user identification). Use the authorization component to ensure only admins can access this page. Display success/error feedback using toast notifications or inline messages. Call the backend's assignCallerUserRole method to grant admin role. Style using the existing design system with shadcn/ui components.

Add a new mutation hook useAssignUserRole that wraps the backend's assignCallerUserRole method. Include proper error handling and success feedback. Invalidate relevant queries (user role queries) upon successful role assignment.
Register a new route for the AdminPanel page at '/admin/users' path. Ensure the route is only accessible when the user is authenticated and has admin privileges.

Add a navigation link to 'Admin Panel' in the header navigation that is conditionally rendered only for users with admin role. Use the useIsCallerAdmin hook to check admin status before displaying the link.

requirements.summary: Implement in-app notification system for new poetry additions
acceptanceCriteria: When a new poem is added, all logged-in users receive an in-app notification
Notifications appear in the existing NotificationBell component
Notification message clearly indicates that new poetry has been added
Users can mark notifications as read

file_operations.description: Ensure the existing notification hooks (useGetNotifications, useMarkNotificationAsRead, useGetUnreadNotificationsCount) properly handle new poetry notifications. The backend already provides these methods, so verify the hooks are correctly configured with appropriate refetch intervals to poll for new notifications periodically (e.g., every 30 seconds for authenticated users).

Verify that the NotificationPanel component properly displays poetry-related notifications with clear messages indicating new poetry has been added. Ensure the mark-as-read functionality works correctly with the existing backend integration. Add any additional styling or message formatting needed to make poetry notifications visually distinct if required.

After successfully submitting a new poem via the submitPoem backend method, trigger a notification fetch or show a confirmation that logged-in users will be notified. This ensures the notification system activates when new poetry is added through the admin form.
